news.headline: Trump approval inches up to 32% ahead of midterms
news.body: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found President Trump’s approval rating rose to 32% in a survey that closed Oct. 26. The poll also showed Democrats leading the generic congressional ballot by roughly 9–11 points, signalling uphill tasks for Republicans before the Nov. 3 midterms.

footerNote: All times converted from official kickoffs
